title: The Eagle, the Cat and the Wild Sow
summary: An eagle nested at the top of an oak, a wild sow at the roots, and a cat in the trunk hollow....
keywords: the eagle, the cat and the wild sow
full_text:
An eagle nested at the top of an oak, a wild sow at the roots, and a cat in the trunk hollow.

The cat told the eagle that the sow planned to uproot the tree, and told the sow that the eagle planned to steal her piglets.

Terrified of leaving their young, neither ventured out to hunt, and both starved to death, leaving their carcasses for the treacherous cat to devour.
moral: A malicious tongue destroys the peace of a peaceful community.
